newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soymeal weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soymeal weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soymeal export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 90,200 MT were 21 percent more than the previous week, but 1 percent less than the 4-week average. Major increases for Saudi Arabia (26,500 MT, reflects 18,000 new sales, 20,000 destination changes and 11,500 foreign purchases/cancellations), the Philippines (18,300 MT), the Dominican Republic (18,000 MT), Algeria (15,000 MT), and Japan (9,700 MT) were partially offset by reductions of 20,000 MT for unknown destinations.
Sales of 69,400 MT for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year were primarily for unknown destinations (63,000 MT).

Exports of 162,000 MT were 54 percent above the previous week and 48 percent more than the 4-week average. The Philippines (52,000 MT), Saudi Arabia (23,500 MT), Venezuela (21,300 MT), Japan (17,500 MT), and the Dominican Republic (16,500 MT) were the major recipients.
